notes: «ح» splits two branches; «جميعا عن الأعمش، بهذا الإسناد» closes both, so the Aʿmash and the back reference are the shared tail
The bare «عيسى» of the second branch is occurrence 2 (occurrence 1 is «عيسى بن يونس» in the first branch)
The report has no saying of its own, only «بهذا الإسناد مثله»
